SecurePayload v3.2.0

Send data between servers safely

It cannot be changed, read by others, or replayed.

Start in 10 minutes Learn the concepts first

Three protections

1

Tampering

The digital seal breaks if contents change.

 2

Eavesdropping

Contents are locked (AEAD) in aead/both.

 3

Replay

One-time tickets plus a logbook.

Who is this for?

Server-to-server APIs, inbound webhooks, or clients that must prove identity with a shared secret or Ed25519.

!
When not

Not a replacement for end-user login or full OAuth. Mode hmac does not encrypt.
